## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover the change, and `pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build` passes.
- [ ] Tenant data or a new endpoint is touched → an isolation test is included.
- [ ] A recorded decision changes → `docs/decisions/` is updated.
- [ ] New screens start from a page pattern and use Carbon components and tokens only.
